logger.doc:name: Log Authentication Error
logger.message: #[output application/java --- '[WARN] Authentication Failed | CorrelationID: ' ++ correlationId ++ ' | IP: ' ++ (attributes.headers['x-forwarded-for'] default attributes.remoteAddress) ++ ' | Timestamp: ' ++ (now() as String)]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { status: "UNAUTHORIZED", errorCode: 401, message: "Authentication failed. Invalid or missing client credentials.", error: "Valid client_id and client_secret headers are required", correlationId: correlationId, timestamp: now() }

logger.doc:name: Log Bad Request
logger.message: #[output application/java --- '[ERROR] Bad Request | CorrelationID: ' ++ correlationId ++ ' | Error: ' ++ (error.description default 'Unknown error') ++ ' | Timestamp: ' ++ (now() as String)]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { status: "BAD_REQUEST", errorCode: 400, message: "Invalid file format or malformed request", error: error.description default "Unknown error", correlationId: correlationId, timestamp: now() }

logger.doc:name: Log Validation Error
logger.message: #[output application/java --- '[WARN] Validation Error | CorrelationID: ' ++ correlationId ++ ' | Error: ' ++ (error.description default 'Unknown error') ++ ' | Timestamp: ' ++ (now() as String)]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { status: "VALIDATION_ERROR", errorCode: 422, message: "Data validation failed", error: error.description default "Unknown error", validationErrors: vars.validationErrors default [], correlationId: correlationId, timestamp: now() }

logger.doc:name: Log System Error
logger.message: #[output application/java --- '[ERROR] System Error | CorrelationID: ' ++ correlationId ++ ' | Error: ' ++ (error.description default 'Unknown error') ++ ' | Timestamp: ' ++ (now() as String)]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { status: "SYSTEM_ERROR", errorCode: 500, message: "Internal system error occurred", error: "Database connection or query execution failed", correlationId: correlationId, timestamp: now() }

logger.doc:name: Log Unexpected Error
logger.message: #[output application/java --- '[ERROR] Unexpected Error | CorrelationID: ' ++ correlationId ++ ' | Error: ' ++ (error.description default 'Unknown error') ++ ' | Timestamp: ' ++ (now() as String)]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { status: "INTERNAL_ERROR", errorCode: 500, message: "An unexpected error occurred", error: error.description default "Unknown error", correlationId: correlationId, timestamp: now() }

logger.doc:name: Log Authentication Attempt
logger.message: #[output application/java --- '[INFO] Authentication Attempt | CorrelationID: ' ++ correlationId ++ ' | ClientID: ' ++ (if (vars.requestClientId != '') vars.requestClientId else 'MISSING') ++ ' | IP: ' ++ (attributes.headers['x-forwarded-for'] default attributes.remoteAddress) ++ ' | Timestamp: ' ++ (now() as String)]

raise-error.description: Missing authentication credentials. Both client_id and client_secret headers are required.
Invalid authentication credentials. The provided client_id or client_secret is incorrect.

logger.doc:name: Log Authentication Success
logger.message: #[output application/java --- '[INFO] Authentication Success | CorrelationID: ' ++ correlationId ++ ' | ClientID: ' ++ vars.requestClientId ++ ' | Timestamp: ' ++ (now() as String)]

logger.doc:name: Log Request Received
logger.message: #[output application/java --- '[INFO] Request Received | CorrelationID: ' ++ correlationId ++ ' | Endpoint: /upload-files | Timestamp: ' ++ (vars.requestStartTime as String)]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 input payload multipart/form-data output application/java --- payload.parts pluck (value, key) -> { partName: key, fileContent: value.content, contentType: value.headers.'Content-Type' default "", fileName: value.headers.'Content-Disposition'.filename default "" }

raise-error.description: No valid files found in request. Please upload CSV or Excel files.

logger.doc:name: Log Files Detected
logger.message: #[output application/java --- '[INFO] Files Detected | CorrelationID: ' ++ correlationId ++ ' | FileCount: ' ++ vars.fileCount ++ ' | Timestamp: ' ++ (now() as String)]

db:insert.doc:name: Insert ACCEPTED Status
db:insert.db:sql: INSERT INTO processing_status (correlation_id, total_files, total_valid, total_invalid, total_inserted, status, started_at) VALUES (:correlationId, :totalFiles, 0, 0, 0, 'ACCEPTED', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ON CONFLICT (correlation_id) DO NOTHING

logger.doc:name: Log Status ACCEPTED Inserted
logger.message: #[output application/java --- '[INFO] Status ACCEPTED inserted | CorrelationID: ' ++ vars.requestCorrelationId ++ ' | TotalFiles: ' ++ vars.fileCount ++ ' | Timestamp: ' ++ (now() as String)]

logger.doc:name: Log Status Insert Failure
logger.message: #[output application/java --- '[ERROR] Could not insert ACCEPTED status | CorrelationID: ' ++ vars.requestCorrelationId ++ ' | Error: ' ++ (error.description default 'Unknown') ++ ' | Timestamp: ' ++ (now() as String)]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { status: "ACCEPTED", message: "Files queued for asynchronous processing", correlationId: vars.requestCorrelationId, filesQueued: vars.fileCount, statusUrl: "/upload-status?correlationId=" ++ vars.requestCorrelationId, timestamp: now() }

logger.doc:name: Log Response Sent
logger.message: #[output application/java --- '[INFO] 202 Response Sent | CorrelationID: ' ++ vars.requestCorrelationId ++ ' | Timestamp: ' ++ (now() as String)]

logger.doc:name: Log Worker Started
logger.message: #[output application/java --- '[INFO] [WORKER] Processing started | CorrelationID: ' ++ correlationId ++ ' | FileCount: ' ++ sizeOf(payload) ++ ' | Timestamp: ' ++ (now() as String)]

db:update.doc:name: Update Status to PROCESSING
db:update.db:sql: UPDATE processing_status SET status = 'PROCESSING' WHERE correlation_id = :correlationId

logger.doc:name: Log PROCESSING Update Failure
logger.message: #[output application/java --- '[WARN] [WORKER] Could not update status to PROCESSING | CorrelationID: ' ++ correlationId ++ ' | Error: ' ++ (error.description default 'Unknown') ++ ' | Timestamp: ' ++ (now() as String)]

logger.doc:name: Log File Processing Start
logger.message: #[output application/java --- '[INFO] [WORKER] File Processing Started | CorrelationID: ' ++ correlationId ++ ' | FileName: ' ++ payload.fileName ++ ' | Timestamp: ' ++ (now() as String)]

logger.doc:name: Log File Parsed
logger.message: #[output application/java --- '[INFO] [WORKER] File Parsed | FileName: ' ++ vars.currentFileName ++ ' | FileType: ' ++ vars.currentFileType ++ ' | Valid: ' ++ vars.currentValidCount ++ ' | Invalid: ' ++ vars.currentInvalidCount ++ ' | Timestamp: ' ++ (now() as String)]

logger.doc:name: Log Unsupported File Type
logger.message: #[output application/java --- '[ERROR] [WORKER] Unsupported File Type | FileName: ' ++ vars.currentFileName ++ ' | Timestamp: ' ++ (now() as String)]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- vars.currentInvalidRecords map { id: $.id, name: $.name, email: $.email, age: $.age, error_message: $.errors joinBy ", ", file_name: vars.currentFileName }

db:bulk-insert.doc:name: Batch Insert to DLQ
db:bulk-insert.db:sql: INSERT INTO dead_letter_queue (id, name, email, age, error_message, file_name, created_at) VALUES (:id, :name, :email, :age, :error_message, :file_name, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET error_message = EXCLUDED.error_message, file_name = EXCLUDED.file_name

logger.doc:name: Log DLQ Insert Success
logger.message: #[output application/java --- '[INFO] [WORKER] DLQ Insert Completed | FileName: ' ++ vars.currentFileName ++ ' | RecordsInserted: ' ++ vars.currentInvalidCount ++ ' | Timestamp: ' ++ (now() as String)]

logger.doc:name: Log DLQ Failure
logger.message: #[output application/java --- '[ERROR] [WORKER] DLQ Insert Failed | FileName: ' ++ vars.currentFileName ++ ' | Error: ' ++ (error.description default 'Unknown') ++ ' | Timestamp: ' ++ (now() as String)]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- do { var validRecords = vars.currentValidRecords var alreadyProcessedEmails = vars.processedEmails var emailGroups = validRecords groupBy $.email var duplicateEmailsInFile = (emailGroups pluck (records, email) -> if (sizeOf(records) > 1) email else null) filter ($ != null) var duplicateEmailsAcrossFiles = validRecords filter (alreadyProcessedEmails contains $.email) map $.email distinctBy $ var allDuplicateEmails = (duplicateEmailsInFile ++ duplicateEmailsAcrossFiles) distinctBy $ var recordsToInsert = validRecords filter !(allDuplicateEmails contains $.email) var duplicateRecords = validRecords filter (allDuplicateEmails contains $.email) --- { recordsToInsert: recordsToInsert, duplicateRecords: duplicateRecords, duplicateCount: sizeOf(duplicateRecords) } }
%dw 2.0 output application/java --- { emailList: vars.recordsToInsert map $.email, emailsForQuery: "'" ++ (vars.recordsToInsert map $.email joinBy "','") ++ "'" }

db:select.doc:name: Batch Check Emails in DB
db:select.db:sql: #["SELECT email FROM employees WHERE email IN (" ++ payload.emailsForQuery ++ ")"]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- vars.finalRecordsToInsert map { name: $.name, email: $.email, age: $.age }

db:bulk-insert.doc:name: Batch Insert Records
db:bulk-insert.db:sql: INSERT INTO employees (name, email, age) VALUES (:name, :email, :age) ON CONFLICT (email) DO NOTHING

logger.doc:name: Log Insert Success
logger.message: #[output application/java --- '[INFO] [WORKER] Records Inserted | FileName: ' ++ vars.currentFileName ++ ' | Count: ' ++ vars.insertedCount ++ ' | Timestamp: ' ++ (now() as String)]

logger.doc:name: Log Insert Failure
logger.message: #[output application/java --- '[ERROR] [WORKER] Batch Insert Failed | FileName: ' ++ vars.currentFileName ++ ' | Error: ' ++ (error.description default 'Unknown') ++ ' | Timestamp: ' ++ (now() as String)]

logger.doc:name: Log File Complete
logger.message: #[output application/java --- '[INFO] [WORKER] File Completed | FileName: ' ++ vars.currentFileName ++ ' | Inserted: ' ++ (vars.insertedCount default 0) ++ ' | Timestamp: ' ++ (now() as String)]

logger.doc:name: Log File Error
logger.message: #[output application/java --- '[ERROR] [WORKER] File Processing Error | FileName: ' ++ (vars.currentFileName default 'unknown') ++ ' | Error: ' ++ (error.description default 'Unknown') ++ ' | Timestamp: ' ++ (now() as String)]

logger.doc:name: Log Worker Complete
logger.message: #[output application/java --- '[INFO] [WORKER] All Files Processed | CorrelationID: ' ++ correlationId ++ ' | TotalInserted: ' ++ vars.totalInserted ++ ' | TotalValid: ' ++ vars.totalValid ++ ' | TotalInvalid: ' ++ vars.totalInvalid ++ ' | ProcessingTime: ' ++ ((now() - vars.workerStartTime) as Number) ++ 'ms | Timestamp: ' ++ (now() as String)]

db:update.doc:name: Update Status to COMPLETED
db:update.db:sql: UPDATE processing_status SET total_valid = :totalValid, total_invalid = :totalInvalid, total_inserted = :totalInserted, status = 'COMPLETED', completed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE correlation_id = :correlationId

logger.doc:name: Log Status COMPLETED
logger.message: #[output application/java --- '[INFO] [WORKER] Status COMPLETED | CorrelationID: ' ++ correlationId ++ ' | Inserted: ' ++ vars.totalInserted ++ ' | Valid: ' ++ vars.totalValid ++ ' | Invalid: ' ++ vars.totalInvalid ++ ' | Timestamp: ' ++ (now() as String)]

logger.doc:name: Log COMPLETED Update Failure
logger.message: #[output application/java --- '[WARN] [WORKER] Could not update status to COMPLETED | CorrelationID: ' ++ correlationId ++ ' | Error: ' ++ (error.description default 'Unknown') ++ ' | Timestamp: ' ++ (now() as String)]

logger.doc:name: Log Worker Fatal Error
logger.message: #[output application/java --- '[ERROR] [WORKER] Unhandled Fatal Error | CorrelationID: ' ++ correlationId ++ ' | Error: ' ++ (error.description default 'Unknown') ++ ' | Timestamp: ' ++ (now() as String)]

db:update.doc:name: Update Status to FAILED
db:update.db:sql: UPDATE processing_status SET status = 'FAILED', completed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE correlation_id = :correlationId

logger.doc:name: Log FAILED Update Failure
logger.message: #[output application/java --- '[ERROR] [WORKER] Could not update status to FAILED | CorrelationID: ' ++ correlationId ++ ' | Timestamp: ' ++ (now() as String)]

logger.doc:name: Log Status Request
logger.message: #[output application/java --- '[INFO] Status Request | CorrelationID: ' ++ (attributes.queryParams.correlationId default 'none') ++ ' | Timestamp: ' ++ (now() as String)]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { status: "BAD_REQUEST", errorCode: 400, message: "correlationId query parameter is required", timestamp: now() }

db:select.doc:name: Get Processing Status
db:select.db:sql: SELECT correlation_id, total_files, total_valid, total_invalid, total_inserted, status, started_at, completed_at FROM processing_status WHERE correlation_id = :correlationId

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { status: "NOT_FOUND", errorCode: 404, message: "No processing record found for the supplied correlationId", correlationId: vars.requestedCorrelationId, timestamp: now() }

logger.doc:name: Log Query Error
logger.message: #[output application/java --- '[ERROR] Status Query Failed | CorrelationID: ' ++ vars.requestedCorrelationId ++ ' | Error: ' ++ (error.description default 'Unknown') ++ ' | Timestamp: ' ++ (now() as String)]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { status: "ERROR", errorCode: 500, message: "Failed to retrieve status information", correlationId: vars.requestedCorrelationId, timestamp: now() }
